## O8 census: `objectstack-ai/cloud` at `777e8e22f1dc254b0912d07ae21530a478c8e790`

Read on 2026-11-23T10:27Z by the card thread for #36115 (session `session_01JQwxbWrBeaAdzGenmHdHuk`), from a fresh `origin/main` checkout.

**Verdict: no hit of any kind.** (1) No outside reader of `buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` / `getReadFilter`. (2) No registration names `sys_record_share`, and no host opts it into `readAudit`. (3) Eight middleware registrations name no object; none changes a read, so none changes a system read of `sys_record_share`. No D-0 finding, so nothing goes back to #33787 and the bump that pins the switch needs no cloud change for O8.

Method: `grep -rn` over `packages/**`, `plugins/**`, `apps/**`, `scripts/**` (`*.ts`, `*.mts`, `*.mjs`, `*.js`, `*.tsx`; `node_modules`/`dist` excluded). Searched: `buildReadFilter|buildWriteFilter|getReadFilter|getWriteFilter|readFilter` (case-insensitive), `ISharingService|SharingService|getService(...'sharing')`, the methods cloud calls on the security service, `registerMiddleware(` (plus the indirect `register.call(` and `ql.on('before…')` spellings), `registerHook(` (literal and variable event names, each variable read to its event list), `beforeFind|afterFind` anywhere, `object: '*'`, `readAudit|recordView|AuditPlugin(`, declarative `events: [...]` and `*.hook.ts`, and `sys_record_share|record_share`. Test files were searched too for parts (1) and (2); none reads the filter or registers on the table.

### (1) Readers of `buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` and of the security service's read filter

| Site | What it is | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| none in code | The only hit is a comment, `packages/security-enterprise/src/hierarchy/cache.ts:8`, which says `buildReadFilter` calls the hierarchy resolver | not a reader |
| `packages/security-enterprise/src/hierarchy/resolver.ts` (`hierarchy-scope-resolver` service) | A **callee** of `buildReadFilter`: it returns owner ids for the hierarchy arm. It never receives or reads the share arm | unaffected |
| security-service calls in `service-ai`, `service-ai-studio`, `service-cloud` | Only `getReadableFields`, `getWritableFields`, `getRecordFieldAccess`, `getEffectiveObjectPermissions`. No read-filter method | not a reader |

No cloud code serialises, walks or matches a sharing filter in process. The two `ast.where` rewriters (`control-plane-org-scope-plugin.ts:460`, `marketplace-visibility-plugin.ts:42`, both `combineWhere`) wrap the existing `where` in `$and` without looking inside it, and they run only on the control-plane objects listed under (2).

### (2) Registrations naming `sys_record_share` (object-scoped middleware, `beforeFind`/`afterFind`, `readAudit.objects`)

None. Every object-scoped registration in cloud, by the object it names:

| Site | Kind | Object(s) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-org-scope-plugin.ts:795` | `beforeFind` | the 18 keys of `SCOPE_RULES` (`:331`): `sys_environment`, `sys_audit_log`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_team`, `sys_app`, `sys_organization`, `sys_member`, `sys_cloud_connection`, `sys_domain`, `sys_quota_usage`, `sys_api_key`, `sys_package_installation`, `sys_environment_credential`, `sys_environment_revision`, `sys_environment_usage`, `sys_billing_payout_accrual`, `sys_slug_reservation`, `sys_billing_invoice_line` |
| `packages/service-cloud/src/read-filter-middleware.ts:90` | object-scoped middleware (count/aggregate), via `registerCountAndAggregateFilter` | callers: `control-plane-org-scope-plugin.ts:799` (same 18), `marketplace-visibility-plugin.ts:206` (`sys_package`), `:228` (`sys_package_version`) |
| `packages/service-cloud/src/marketplace-visibility-plugin.ts:202`, `:224` | `beforeFind` | `sys_package`, `sys_package_version` |
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/env-admin-projection.ts:994` | object-scoped middleware | `sys_account` |
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/environment-one-organization-guard.ts:180` | object-scoped middleware | `sys_organization` |

Write hooks (`beforeInsert/Update/Delete`, `afterInsert/Update/Delete`) are not in the class and none names the table either (`env-admin-projection.ts:1027-1028` `sys_user_permission_set`; `control-plane-org-scope-plugin.ts:877` the same 18; `environment-admin-projection.ts:398-400` and `environment-identity-revocation.ts:1017-1018` `sys_member`, `:1153-1154` `sys_session`; `platform-sso.ts:823` `sys_organization`; `audit-compliance-plugin.ts:398` `sys_audit_log`/`sys_ai_audit_log`; the AI-model, conversation and ledger guards on their own AI objects).

`readAudit`: cloud constructs `AuditPlugin` twice and never passes it. `packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-preset.ts:969` passes only `getLocale`. The per-environment loader (`packages/objectos-runtime/src/capability-loader.ts:482-485`) declares `audit` with no `configKey`, so a tenant bundle cannot hand it options (`:1242`). No hit for `readAudit` anywhere in cloud.

### (3) Registrations naming no object that change a system read of `sys_record_share`

Eight middleware registrations name no object. None alters a query or a result on any read:

| Site | What it acts on | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/env-owner-admin-grant.ts:381` | after `next()`, insert/create only | no read change |
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/first-record-report.ts:245` (body `:208`) | after `next()`, a person's insert on a non-`sys_` app object | no read change |
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/activation-funnel-report.ts:269` (body `:217`) | after `next()`, fires a telemetry report on a non-system person read of a non-`sys_` object (`isPersonRead` `:162`, `countsAsAppObject` in `first-record-report.ts:153`); never touches the query or result | observes only; skips system reads and `sys_*` |
| `packages/objectos-runtime/src/environment-agent-account-plan-gate.ts:459` (body `:369`) | `sys_user` insert, `sys_member` insert/update; everything else `next()` | no read change |
| `packages/service-cloud/src/developer-member-cap.ts:584` (body `:455`, `membershipInsert` `:337`) | `sys_member`/`sys_invitation` insert | no read change |
| `packages/service-cloud/src/active-org-session-hook.ts:147` | after `next()`, `sys_member` insert | no read change |
| `packages/service-cloud/src/invitation-acceptance-verified-address.ts:267` (body `:199`, `isInvitationAcceptance` `:148`) | `sys_invitation` update to `accepted` | no read change |
| `packages/security-enterprise/src/ai-seat/ai-seat-plugin.ts:396` | `sys_user`, `sys_member`, `sys_user_permission_set` writes | no read change |

No find hook names no object, and nothing registers on `'*'`.

### Outside the three kinds, noted for the seat

- `packages/objectos-runtime/src/tenant-sharing-rule-mirrors.ts:233` reads `sys_record_share` itself, as the system, through `engine.find`. It is a direct read of the table, not a sharing-scoped read, so the switch does not touch it.
- `packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-proxy-driver.ts:30` (`ControlPlaneProxyDriver`) is a driver wrapper that adds an `organization_id` filter. It is not mounted anywhere in the repo (its header, and `artifact-kernel-factory.ts:14`), so no sharing-scoped object is bound to it today. If a host mounts it, that is D4's first class (another datasource), not O8's.
- Tenant app hooks bound at runtime by the platform's hook binder are tenant-authored, not in this tree. They are D4's boundary, and the switch changeset tells the host, as #33787 notes.

## Closure — completed · 2026-11-23T10:30Z

- **Census:** the card thread (claim 7097966054) read `objectstack-ai/cloud` at `777e8e22f1dc`. The census is comment 7098018847 and the report is 7098047315.
  1. **Readers:** there is no reader of `buildReadFilter`, `buildWriteFilter` or `getReadFilter` outside plugin-sharing. The EE hierarchy resolver is called by `buildReadFilter`; it never reads the filter.
  2. **Registrations:** no middleware, find hook or `readAudit` opt-in names `sys_record_share`, and `AuditPlugin` is built without `readAudit` on both paths.
  3. **Read-changing middleware:** eight middleware registrations name no object, and none of them changes a read.
- **Result:** no D-0 finding, and nothing to raise on #33787. The cloud bump that pins the ADR-0155 step 6 switch needs no O8 change.
- **Card:** this card was a reading, so there is no PR. It closes now because the census is recorded. A later cloud change that adds one of the three kinds is a new reading against #33787.
